sections.title: What We’ll Discuss in this Lesson:
JAGGAER Advantage: Sourcing+
paragraphs: Sourcing+ Makes it easier and faster to run effective RFx events, with powerful tools to streamline processes, distribute invitations, collect and evaluate bids.

sections.title: What’s Important
paragraphs: • RFI – used to collect Qualification and Technical information from suppliers in order to evaluate the supplier base and to narrow the field of competition to qualified suppliers. Cannot be awarded.
• RFQ – used to collect detailed Technical and Commercial information from pre -qualified suppliers in the form of a private offer. Can be awarded.
• Program Manager – Configuration of workflows with defined tasks and task schedules
• Auctions – provides for simultaneous negotiation between a buyer and multiple suppliers in an electronic environment.

sections.title: Sourcing+: RFQ Forms Usage

• Provide an area for data essential to third party integrations
